title: So so quality.
text: So so quality.. I certainly liked the color and size of these vases but was disappointed in the lack of uniformity the color had around the vases.  The striping on the larger vase was inconsistent in color from the bottom to the top.  Also, the tall vase was a different color blue from the shorter one.  I kept them, but I have to keep one particular side facing the wall due to a defect in each vase on one side.
